sam: FYI I'll be embedded with a client in Accra for ~30 days (2026-10-05 -> 2026-11-04). Company will cover apartment + flights. Quick Qs: 1) Do I need to change homebase? 2) Will the $150 WFH stipend be paused or prorated? 3) Can People Ops ship my MacBook to Ghana? 4) Any tax/immigration flags I should know about? @rita (People Ops) @omar (Payroll) @travel-team @legal @benefits
rita (People Ops): Congrats on the engagement. Short answers: a) temporary stays <90 days usually don't force a homebase change if you remain on Redwood payroll. b) stipend is prorated; if you're away >50% business days in a calendar month we pause that month's payment. c) laptop shipping OK but needs asset tracking and courier temporary import docs. d) Payroll/Legal will confirm tax/visa needs once you file the Temporary Location Declaration in Workday.
sam: We're staying on Redwood payroll. Travel team will book the apartment. If company pays for internet at the apartment, does that automatically cancel the stipend for that month?
omar (Payroll): We prorate by calendar days at your primary home workspace. If company provides lodging + internet and you're physically in Accra >50% business days in that month, stipend is paused. Company-paid housing can be a taxable fringe in some jurisdictions; we'll route to tax counsel. Please submit the Workday temp location so we can flag payroll.
travel-team: We can book and ship. For equipment shipments: courier uses temporary import docs (waybill + carnet-like paperwork). You'll sign return receipt and asset will remain company property. If customs duties are applicable, Travel will coordinate pre-clearance with Legal.
legal: Immigration note: Ghana allows short business visits, but "working" onsite may be sensitive. For 30 days it's usually fine but we need a short scope-of-work (meetings, pairing, mentoring, billable delivery?) on the Workday form. Also flag if you'll be providing services to a local entity.
benefits: Medical plan note: short stays are typically covered but out-of-network rates may apply. If you plan extended local care, submit pre-authorization. Add emergency contact and local phone in Workday.
sam: Filing Temporary Location Declaration now. One last: is there any one-off support for family or short-stay relocation costs (pet transport, short-term lease overlap)? Policy mentions permanent relocations only but wondering about exceptions.
rita (People Ops): We occasionally approve a `TEMP_SUPPORT` one-time allowance (up to $1,500) for short-term family or logistics needs, manager sign-off required. Add a brief justification on the Workday form and tag People Ops. We'll review with Finance.
sam: Thanks everyone 44d submitting now and looping manager + legal.
